Name: Fish Preview
Author: Jonqora
Description:
[size=6][b]﻿Fish Preview[/b][/size]
[i]Was that an octopus? It got away... we'll never know....

[/i]This mod works during the fishing minigame to show a preview image of the fish you are currently catching. Fish species you have caught before will show the preview; uncaught fish species show as "???" (configurable). Also works in other languages and with mods that add new fish.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6303/6303-1592364426-1362134246.jpeg[/img]

[size=4][b]COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley v1.4 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac and Windows;
[*]Partially compatible on Android (some config options do not work);
[*]Single-player and multiplayer (works for any player who has it installed).
[*]Compatible with new fish added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6212]More New Fish[/url]﻿ (and probably other mods too).
[*]Works in all officially-supported languages.
[/list]
[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod from the link in the header above.
[*]Unzip the mod and place the [code]FishPreview[/code] folder inside your [code]Mods[/code] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4][b]CONFIG OPTIONS[/b][/size]
After running SMAPI with Fish Preview installed, a [code]config.json[/code] file will be created. Open it in any text editor to change your settings:

[b]FishDisplayPosition:[/b] Choose where you want the preview to appear (see image below).
[list]
[*]Options: [code]Top[/code], [code]UpperLeft[/code], [code]UpperRight[/code], [code]LowerLeft[/code], [code]LowerRight[/code], [code]Bottom[/code]
[/list][b]ShowFishName:[/b] Shows the text of the fish name under the icon. Default is [code]true[/code].
[b]ShowUncaughtFishSpecies:[/b] Show preview for all fish species, even ones you have never caught. Default is [code]false[/code].
[b]AlwaysShowLegendaryFish:[/b] Show preview for legendary fish. Default is [code]false[/code].

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6303/6303-1592377175-756345331.jpeg[/img]
